diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.1 gives eta=(-h,-h+2h omega), h=1/12. Label 1 is fixed at the centre of label 2’s radius-2h anticlockwise circle. The second coordinate has modulus at most 3h=1/4, so both coordinates lie in the open unit disk.

Step 2.1 gives (-h omega,h omega). In both panels the difference is 2h omega, never zero because |omega|=1. At t=0 and 1 the ordered pair is (-h,h); at t=1/2 the centred pair is (h,-h). Dots show endpoints, not simultaneous occupation of the entire drawn tracks.

The local elementary-half-twist definition has label 1 going below the midpoint on the positive anticlockwise half turn. The blue arc starts at the left point and increases angles 180 to 295 degrees; label 2 starts at right and increases 0 to 115 degrees. These agree with the first round half turn; the next half turn repeats the positive generator after label exchange. Steps 1.3 and 2.1 identify the two round half turns with the stacked diamond sigma_1 star sigma_1, hence step 3.1 gives [sigma_1]^2.

Step 2.2 has H_2(0,t)=beta_round and H_2(1,t)=eta with fixed ordered endpoints, nonzero difference, and disk bound 3h. The two-headed H_2 connector denotes this isotopy, not temporal motion or an equality of literal paths. Step 4.1 retains Psi([beta_eta])=(iota^F_*[eta])^{-1}; the figure claims only the loop-to-trace full-twist identity.
